mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening labor market that triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 8.5%), or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between low federal funds rates and high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5%) signals a 'growth at all costs' monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) does not yield a positive Rank IC above 0.05 in any 3-year window, or the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST above 500 thousand units) signal strong consumer demand and positive economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST exceeds 500k, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS rising for three consecutive months) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that triggers recession fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 90), or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS above 4.0%) signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between strong housing starts (HOUST above 500 thousand units) and robust industrial production (INDPRO above 95) signals a synchronized expansion in consumer and business activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) does not yield a positive Rank IC above 0.05 in any 3-year window, or the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.
